title.en: Preface to the Commentary on the Nine Chapters

edition.en: Complete, as given at the head of the main Jiuzhang suanshu page of Chinese Wikisource; the closing attribution line is omitted, and one character dropped in the Wikisource transcription (為, in 表高乘表間為實) is restored from the Siku quanshu text (Kanseki Repository KR3f0032).
edition.zh: 全文，据维基文库《九章算术》主页面卷首；不录末尾的署名括注。维基文库录文脱一“为”字（表高乘表间为实），据《四库全书》本（Kanseki Repository 汉籍库 KR3f0032）补。

basis.en: Text of the Three Kingdoms period, written in 263; public domain everywhere.
basis.zh: 三国时期文本，作于 263 年，在全世界属于公有领域。

note.en: Liu Hui's preface of 263 to his commentary on the Nine Chapters: where the book came from, why he wrote the commentary, and a worked method for measuring the height and size of the sun with two gnomons and a sighting tube. The geometry is sound, but it rests on the assumption of a flat earth, so the distances it gives for the sun are far too small; what lasted was the method of measuring the unreachable from two points. Notice his remark that the branches divide but share one trunk.
note.zh: 刘徽 263 年为《九章算术》作注时写的序：讲此书来历、作注缘由，并给出用两根表杆和一支窥管测日高、日径的方法。几何本身无误，但建立在大地是平面的假设上，所以求得的日高、日远都远小于实际；流传下来的是从两点测量不可及之物的方法。留意他说“枝条虽分而同本干”。

excerpt.orig: 雖夫圓穹之象猶曰可度，又況泰山之高與江海之廣哉。
excerpt.en: If even the image of the round vault of heaven can be measured, how much more the height of Mount Tai and the breadth of the rivers and seas.
excerpt.zh: 虽夫圆穹之象犹曰可度，又况泰山之高与江海之广哉。

gloss.en: Fu Xi, the legendary first sovereign, credited with inventing the trigrams, writing and nets.
gloss.zh: 即伏羲，传说中的上古帝王，相传创制八卦。

gloss.en: The eight trigrams of the Book of Changes, each made of three whole or broken lines.
gloss.zh: 《周易》中由三条阳爻或阴爻组成的八种基本图形。

gloss.en: The 'nine nines': the multiplication table, which in China ran downward from nine times nine.
gloss.zh: 九九乘法口诀。古代从“九九八十一”开始念起，故称九九。

gloss.en: The six lines of a hexagram in the Book of Changes.
gloss.zh: 《周易》每卦的六条爻。

gloss.en: 恊 is an old form of 協: to bring the twelve pitch pipes into harmony.
gloss.zh: 恊，同“协”。调和十二律。律吕，古代的定音管。

gloss.en: The two modes (yin and yang) and the four images that grow from them, in the cosmology of the Book of Changes.
gloss.zh: 《周易·系辞》：“太极生两仪，两仪生四象。”两仪指阴阳。

gloss.en: Lishou, said to have been a minister of the Yellow Emperor, was credited with inventing arithmetic.
gloss.zh: 隶首，传说是黄帝的臣子，创造了算数。

gloss.en: The nine arts of reckoning taught to young nobles in the Rites of Zhou; Han commentators list them under names much like the chapter titles of the Nine Chapters.
gloss.zh: 《周礼》中贵族子弟所学的九种算法，汉代注家所列的名目与《九章》的篇名大体相同。

gloss.en: The burning of the books by the First Emperor of Qin in 213 BCE.
gloss.zh: 公元前 213 年秦始皇焚书。

gloss.en: Zhang Cang (d. 152 BCE), Marquis of Beiping, chancellor under the early Han and a master of calendars and numbers.
gloss.zh: 张苍（？—前 152），封北平侯，西汉初年丞相，精通历法和算术。

gloss.en: Geng Shouchang (1st century BCE), a finance official and astronomer under Emperor Xuan of the Han.
gloss.zh: 耿寿昌，西汉宣帝时的财政官员和天文学家。

gloss.en: To search out what is hidden and profound, a phrase from the Book of Changes.
gloss.zh: 探求深奥隐微的道理。语出《周易·系辞》“探赜索隐”。

gloss.en: Dull and slow: a modest way of speaking of his own ability.
gloss.zh: 愚钝，自谦之词。

gloss.en: Liu Hui's picture of mathematics as one tree: many methods, a single trunk.
gloss.zh: 刘徽把数学看作一棵树：方法千枝万叶，根干只有一个。

gloss.en: To grasp more than half of it, an expression from the Book of Changes.
gloss.zh: 能领会一大半。语出《周易·系辞》。

gloss.en: The six arts of a gentleman's education: rites, music, archery, charioteering, writing and calculation.
gloss.zh: 古代教育的六门功课：礼、乐、射、御、书、数。

gloss.en: The sons of the nobility, taught at the royal court.
gloss.zh: 贵族子弟。

gloss.en: The compass and the carpenter's square.
gloss.zh: 圆规和曲尺。

gloss.en: The Rites of Zhou, in its account of the duties of the Grand Minister of Education.
gloss.zh: 《周礼·地官·大司徒》。周官，即《周礼》。

gloss.en: A gnomon: an upright post eight feet high whose noon shadow is measured.
gloss.zh: 表，测日影用的直立标杆，高八尺。

gloss.en: The centre of the earth: the place where the solstice shadow measured exactly a foot and a half.
gloss.zh: 大地的中心，即夏至正午表影恰为一尺五寸的地方。

gloss.en: The point directly beneath the sun at noon. The figure rests on the Han assumption of a flat earth, on which the shadow grows by an inch for every thousand li.
gloss.zh: “戴日下”指太阳正下方的地点。此数基于汉代大地为平面、“寸差千里”的假设。

gloss.en: The method of double differences: measuring a distant object from two sighting posts. Liu Hui's chapter on it later circulated alone as the Sea Island Mathematical Manual.
gloss.zh: 用两根表杆测量远处目标的方法。刘徽所撰《重差》后来单独流传，即《海岛算经》。

gloss.en: Luoyang, capital of the Wei state, where Liu Hui probably worked.
gloss.zh: 曹魏的都城，刘徽大概在此工作。

gloss.en: 法 is the divisor and 實 the dividend: here the difference between the two shadows is the divisor.
gloss.zh: 法，除数；实，被除数。以两表影长之差作除数。

gloss.en: A tube, used as a sighting instrument.
gloss.zh: 竹筒，用作窥管。

gloss.en: Stacked set-squares, used to sight down into a depth.
gloss.zh: 叠用多个矩尺测深。

gloss.en: An object standing alone and far off needs three sightings; one that must also be reached from the side needs four.
gloss.zh: 孤立的远处目标要测望三次；还须从旁推求的，要测望四次。
